decision_conditions:
S73 - CONSENT LIMITED TO THAT OF ORIGINAL PERMISSION: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of 06 September 2027. 

REASON: To ensure the commencement timescale for the development is not extended beyond that of the original planning permission granted on 06 September 2024 LBI ref:P2024/1809/FUL. Furthermore, to comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
description:
S73 application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary the wording of condition 2 (DRAWING AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS) of planning permission ref:  P2024/1809/FUL (Rear lower ground floor extension, additional and changes to windows on side and rear elevation, including the removal of Juliet balcony at ground floor to  be replaced by window), dated 06/09/2024, for the following amendments: 

a)   replacement and change the design of the three windows on the first, second and third floors in the rear elevation
